tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// las mgon dregs pa yongs kyi rje btsan 'khor 'das kyi zhing skyong gzi ldan legs grub rdo rje'i lam khyer las kyi byang bu bzhugs so//

shrī he ru ka la na mo: las mgon dregs pa yongs kyi rje btsan/ 'khor 'das kyi zhing skyong legs grub rdo rje'i lam khyer las kyi byang bu ni/ ho dgongs su gsol lo: ho dgongs su gsol lo: ho dgongs su gsol lo: bdud mgon nag po chen po seng ge'i gdong pa can: zhing skyong chen po ga ya dha ra: kun dga' gzhon nu: legs grub rdo rje: k+ṣe tra pā la: lho btsan nag po: yum mchog bdud mo khrag ral ma: dpal 'bar si na ra ma: las mkhan bam ro pho mo: ma sring dregs pa sde brgyad: khyed rnams sngon tshe kun bzang yab yum: rig 'dzin pad+ma: hūm̐ kā ra: rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje 'dus pa rtsal rnams kyi spyan sngar khas blangs dam gyis bcas pa bzhin du: rgyal ba'i zhing khams rnam dag: dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad: sbas yul pad+ma bkod: tsa ri ko ṭa yaḥ ban ri pad+ma 'od nas: mchod cing sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir skad cig myur ba nyid du spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: hūm̐ bh+yo: dur khrod chen po mkha' spyod tsa ri nas: che mchog kun gyi phrin las gcig bsdus pa: zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu yab yum dang: bka' nyan las byed dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs: sngon gyi dam bca' gnyan po ma g.yel bar: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐ bh+yo: sngon tshe pad+ma dbang dang pad 'byung spyan snga ru: seng gdong khyod kyis ci ltar khas blangs bzhin: phrin las drag po'i las la spyan 'dren no: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba'i phyir: ma thogs gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐ bh+yo: sde brgyad yongs kyi dmag dpon mdzad tsa na: dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal nas gshegs su gsol: seng gdong sprul pa grangs med 'gyed tsa na: gangs dkar ti se'i gnas nas gshegs= sgrub brgyud bstan pa phyogs bcur spel tsa na: 'brog chen la phyi'i gnas nas gshegs= ma mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso bo mdzad tsa na:

rnam dag o rgyan gnas nas gshegs= zab gter bka' srung srung ma mdzad tsa na: ban ri pad+ma 'od nas gshegs su gsol: gsang sngags bstan pa phyogs bcur spel tsa na: rnam dag mkha' spyod gnas nas gshegs= rnal 'byor dgra bla chen po mdzad tsa na: de wī ko ṭi'i gnas nas gshegs= bstan pa'i ru tra ma lus bsgral tsa na: mthu stobs drag po'i gnas nas gshegs su gsol: hūm̐ bh+yo: bdud mgon seng gdong yab yum dang: dregs pa sde brgyad dmag tshogs rnams: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol: gsang sngags bstan pa spel phyir gshegs= rnal 'byor dgra bla mdzad phyir gshegs= log 'dren byad ma 'dul phyir gshegs= sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul phyir gshegs= rgyal 'gong dam sri 'dul phyir gshegs= dgra bgegs jing dur bzlog phyir gshegs= mi nad phyugs nad bzlog phyir gshegs= nad mug mtshon 'khrug bzlog phyir gshegs= mi mthun rkyen ngan bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐ bh+yo: dur khrod rab 'jigs 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su: gru gsum mthing nag e yi klong dkyil du: zhing bcu'i dgra bgegs byad ma bsnol ba'i steng: bdud mgon seng gdong yab yum 'khor dang bcas: dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐ bh+yo: chos sku skye med kun bzang he ru ka: longs sku 'gag med dpal chen seng ge'i sgra: sprul sku bdud mgon seng ge'i gdong pa can: mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul nus pa'i shugs 'chang ba: zhing skyong gzi ldan yab yum 'khor bcas la: gnyis med gus pa'i tshul gyis phyag 'tshal lo: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: hūm̐ bh+yo: zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu yab yum 'khor bcas la: dam rdzas dgyes mchod sna tshogs 'bul ba ni: sha khrag la sogs ba liṃ mchod pa 'bul: thugs dam dbang gis dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol: dbang po lnga sogs keng rus mchod pa 'bul: rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis bar chad thams cad zlog:

klad khrag la sogs bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: sprul pa'i stobs kyis mi mthun 'gal rkyen zlog: snying khrag la sogs nang rol gsang mchod 'bul: bzhad pa'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: ga ṇa la sogs longs spyod mchod pa 'bul: 'dod pa'i dngos grub ma lus bdag la stsol: mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chad zlog tu gsol: oṃ tri shrī badz+ra ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa: tri hring dza: dhā ki nī tri si na ra ma hūm̐ phaṭa: tri hriṃ dza: tsa na phaṭa: siṃ ha bh+yo: dh+ri tri: ya ma ra tsa du tri phu tri: badz+ra k+ṣe tra pā la: na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hāḥ i daṃ ba liṃ ta gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ bhuñdza hoḥ rak+ta ar+ghaṃ pi pa to a ti kra ma sa ma ye swā hāḥ sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hiḥ ma hā badz+ra pad+ma yo gi ni a ho su kha hoḥ dam ldan rnal 'byor bdag dang bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra 'dre byur ltas ngan byad kha rbod gtong kha mchu mi kha dmag jag chom rkun mtshon dug sbyor ngan shom pa dang*/ bran slob snying ring dam tshig ngos lkog dngos shag lkog lab mgo bskor gsang 'khyal mna' zan brang rkun 'gro 'go dud mjug ngo log rgyab bstan bka' 'das khrims 'gal byed pa'i/ tshe bla srog dbugs drod mdangs thams cad mā ra ya kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ ma hā māṃ sa la khā hiḥ ma hā tsit+ta la khā hiḥ ma hā rak+ta la khā hiḥ ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hiḥ ma hā ba su ta la khā hiḥ ma hā kin ni ri ti la khā hiḥ ma traṃ ru tra pra bhan tsakra hūm̐ phaṭaḥ e s+pha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ sarba ma mi ka yi sarba a dhi sid+dhi ye swā hāḥ hūm̐ bh+yo: dur khrod bdag po zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong: de yi yum chen srin mo seng gdong ma: bkra shis dpal 'bar nor gyi dngos grub ster: stobs chen yid 'gugs lha mo dbyings phyug ma:

dur khrod bdag mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ bh+yo: bkra shis chen mo mthu stobs rno la myur: zlog pas mi bzlog sngags zlog dgra bo'i gshed: rbod gtong phar brlag nus pa rang gshed 'beb: bdud mgon seng gdong sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dregs pa 'dul zhing dgra bgegs kun gyi gshed: ltas ngan cho 'phrul rgyug pa'i zhor la 'beb: dam nyams tshe srog glo bur sdud mdzad pa: drag po sgrol byed gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: nang du zhi zhing bkra shis bu nor spel: phyi ru khros pas rtsub 'gyur 'jig rten g.yo: ba dan phyar bas sangs rgyas bstan pa srung: g.yu ral bsigs pas seng chung skar ltar 'khrugs: zhing skyong dpal 'bar thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ bh+yo: spyan dmar glog 'khyug srid gsum 'od kyis gang: ljags dmar brdabs pas sa gzhi g.yo zhing 'khrugs: dmar gtor gdengs pas nad yams char bzhin 'beb: bdud rta brgyugs pas lha srin brgyal zhing 'bog: dmag dpon seng gdong dgra 'dul sku la bstod: hūm̐ bh+yo: bstan pa bsrung zhing bka' yi bya ra mdzad: rnal 'byor mgo 'don sngags 'chang tshe srog sring: nang du zhi bas yid bzhin lha mo 'du: phyi ru khros pas phra men ser ltar 'khrugs: dam nyams drug khri nyin bzhin gsod par byed: gung gnyis rgyug pas dkor rkun rtsad nas gcod: rno myur seng gdong sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: zlog pas mi bzlog gzhan gyis mi chun zhing: bka' srung bdud tshogs dgra la rang gshed 'beb: bdag la byams shing nang du dngos grub ster: bkra shis snying nye grogs ltar rtag tu srung: gsung sgrog gcig thos las ni tshar gsum bsgrub: bu ltar srung zhing khyo ltar skyong ba'i lha: dhā ki seng gdong gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: gsang sngags bka' srung rnal 'byor dgra bla che: bdud kyi g.yul 'joms ma rungs dgra bgegs sgrol: rdzu 'phrul mthu yis lha srin dbang sdud cing:

sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i las la brtson: srin mo'i gzugs kyis dgra la nad yams 'beb: dpal 'bar seng gdong thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ bh+yo: yab yum gnyis kyi bka' nyan mthu rtsal can: bam ro pho mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bka' yi las byed shan pa sde brgyad tshogs: dregs pa lcam dral rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ bh+yo: dam nyams dgra la ltas ngan sna tshogs gtong: skyes bu chen po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam nyams dgra bgegs ma lus khram la 'debs: gshin rje chos rgyal sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam nyams dgra la mdze nad char bzhin 'beb: klu bdud mgo dgu'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam nyams dgra bgegs ma lus zhags pas 'ching: bdud rje nag po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam nyams dgra la ye 'drog sna tshogs gtong: btsan 'gong chen po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam nyams dgra la 'ja' 'khyil ltas ngan gtong: lha bdud dkar po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam nyams dgra bgegs dmod pa'i mtshon chas phung: srin po dhar dhi'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam nyams dgra la khrag nad char bzhin 'beb: rdo rje ba lam sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ bh+yo: gzhan yang las mkhan dregs pa'i dmag tshogs ni: gtso bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa: bstan pa'i dgra bgegs thal ba rdul bzhin rlog: bka' nyan las byed tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces gsang bdag siṃ ha ghaṇ+ḍe rgyal ba'i bstan srung du skur snang ba'i zhing skyong chen po 'di nyid snying nye mthu myur tshan che bkra shis 'khu ldog nyung ste/ 'di'i sgrub thabs gsar ma 'ga' zhig dang rnying ma'i gter kha mang po yod kyang*/ 'di ni khrag 'thung nus ldan bdud 'dul rdo rje'i gter byung ltar te/ sgrub thabs mang lha ngo bo gcig pas 'dir ma 'dus pa med cing lhag tu zab myur 'di rang che bas brtson 'tshal zhing*/ khyad par rang re'i chos brgyud la 'go ba'i lha mchog go
/zhes gter gzhung las byang nas rig 'dzin chen po tshe dbang nor bus khyer bde khol du phyung zhing gtor 'bul khā hi sbyar bar mdzad pa'o// dge'o// dge'o// dge'o/// /
